name: Wizard OS Tracker
short_desc: The Wizard OS team's build line: goals, bugs and the builder, on top of GitHub. Team members only.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Two views over a GitHub organisation, Goals and Bugs, each showing the assembly line Queued → Building → AI review → Human review → Done as big numbers with arrows, each bin with its typical time range and a target tick and two return arrows (from AI review and from Human review) with their kick-back rates (tap a bin to filter to that stage; under each bin its shared target, editable, and ⓘ for who does it), a Builder switch (mock-up), Who and repo chip filters (stable order) and a sort on Bugs, and a Try it switch on items in Review (mock-up). Tap an issue to read it and its comments in the app. Each person signs in with their own GitHub token. Team members only: you sign in with your own GitHub account and must be an active member of humanitylabs-org; agent accounts use the MCP tools instead. Sign in with GitHub (device flow) when the box has a client id, or with a token.
